ios.desc:
Ratatosk VPN — Encrypted. Invisible. Free.

When other VPNs get blocked, Ratatosk keeps you connected. Built on next-generation stealth technology (V2Ray/Reality), Ratatosk gives you private, censorship-resistant access to the open internet — with no account and no logs.

WHY RATATOSK

• No sign-up, no email. Your identity is a single anonymous account number — nothing ties the app to you.
• Stealth that beats blocks. On-device detection spots when your network is being filtered (DPI, DNS or TLS interference) and automatically switches to Reality-grade stealth so you stay connected.
• One app, every protocol. WireGuard, Hysteria2, VLESS, VMess, Trojan and Shadowsocks — the right protocol for every network.
• Strict no-logs. We don't keep records of the sites you visit or what you do online.
• Strong encryption everywhere. Modern, military-grade encryption protects every connection — especially on public Wi-Fi in hotels, cafes and airports.

ONE TAP TO FREEDOM
Open the app and tap once. Auto-connect and auto-reconnect keep you protected as you move between networks. A clean, fast interface in 22 languages, with 14 themes.

MORE THAN A VPN
Ratatosk also includes a built-in private browser plus handy tools: speed test, ping, IP info and a secure password generator.

FREE & PREMIUM
Use Ratatosk free on our standard servers, or upgrade to Premium for unlimited connections, our fastest servers and an ad-free experience.

SUBSCRIPTION
Ratatosk Premium is an auto-renewing subscription, available monthly or yearly. Prices are shown in your local currency in the app before you purchase.
- Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends.
- Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

PRIVACY
Your privacy is the whole point. We follow a strict no-logs policy for your VPN traffic and we never sell your browsing activity.

Privacy Policy: https://lukayn.com/en/privacy
Terms of Use: https://lukayn.com/en/terms

quotes.text:
Hey HN! I built a VPN using V2Ray protocol after getting frustrated with 
commercial VPNs being blocked in Turkey/China/Iran.

Unlike OpenVPN/WireGuard, V2Ray mimics HTTPS traffic and bypasses DPI.

Tech stack: Flutter + V2Ray core. No user accounts = zero data to log.

Free tier with ads, optional premium. Would love technical feedback!

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vpn-v2ray-ratatosk/id6742348919?platform=iphone
